title: Idea rules are site settings, with a premise-led idea mode
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-e7f023 and HUM-e155f8.

The two-citation minimum and the point check's verdicts are code. Make them per-site settings, and add an idea mode that starts from one real Reference and states an invented premise separately.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in #1420. Decision: idea rules live in the router publication's monitorStories policy as 'ideaRules' (minimumReferences, requireJointSentence, passingVerdicts, checkRepeats, checkProcessTalk, mode evidence|premise-led), not a guideline document, because the router has no read access to site documents and this needed no new grants. Premise-led: one real Reference, an invented premise stored apart (evidence.premise, an 'Invented premise' section), no point check. The CLI monitor-stories run still uses the default rules (no flag; YAGNI).
